rows.pot: Unclaimed accrued US digital mechanicals under the blanket licence, 2021 usage onward
rows.who_can_claim: Songwriters, publishers and administrators whose songs earned US streaming mechanicals that the MLC could not match or pay out.
rows.how_to_claim: Register the songs with the MLC, claim any missing shares, and propose matches for unmatched recordings. Remaining money is then shared by market share.
rows.rule: The MLC plans to start market-share payouts in April 2027, beginning with January 2021 usage, one month at a time. This is a start date, not a deadline.

rows.pot: Historical unmatched US streaming mechanicals from 2007 to 2020
rows.who_can_claim: Owners of musical works used in US streaming before 2021 whose use the services could not match to a copyright owner.
rows.how_to_claim: Join the MLC, register your works, then use its matching tool to propose links between unmatched recordings and your songs. Approved matches are paid with interest.
rows.rule: As of November 2026 the MLC says its market-share process for what stays unmatched has not begun. It gives no claim cut-off date on the page.

rows.pot: US digital mechanicals held for rightsholders who have not yet joined the MLC
rows.who_can_claim: Writers, publishers and collective bodies listed in the lookup under their own name or the name they collect under.
rows.how_to_claim: Search your name in the Missing Member Lookup. If it appears, sign up as an MLC Member to collect the digital audio mechanicals owed to you.
rows.rule: The lookup leaves out historical unmatched royalties, so a hit shows only part of what may be owed. The page states no claim cut-off.
rows.cost: Free lookup and free to join

rows.holder: Publishers and administrators that receive unclaimed distributions
rows.pot: The songwriter's share of any unclaimed accrued royalties a publisher receives from the MLC
rows.who_can_claim: Songwriters whose works a publisher licenses or administers for US digital mechanicals, or their authorised agents.
rows.how_to_claim: When your publisher or administrator receives an MLC unclaimed distribution, ask for the payment or credit due to you and for the usage data behind it.
rows.rule: By statute the songwriter is paid or credited by usage, and never less than half of what the owner received for that songwriter's works, whatever the contract says.

rows.pot: US digital performance royalties for unregistered artists and sound recording owners
rows.who_can_claim: Recording artists, performers and sound recording owners who have not registered, and are named on recordings played on non-interactive services.
rows.how_to_claim: Use the search on SoundExchange's page to see if you appear on one of its unregistered lists. Then register for free and claim your recordings in SX Direct.
rows.rule: The page says registration is required to be paid. It gives no time limit for claiming, so check with SoundExchange before assuming money is safe.

rows.pot: Canadian online mechanicals for recordings or shares not yet matched to a work
rows.who_can_claim: Publishers that own or control musical works and hold a CMRRA Direct account; writers usually go through their publisher.
rows.how_to_claim: Get a CMRRA Direct publisher account, open Unclaimed Works, match unmatched recordings to your works, and add missing ownership shares for review.
rows.rule: After CMRRA verifies the submission, its quarterly invoicing covers past and current use. The page gives no claim cut-off date.
rows.cost: No fee stated on the page

rows.pot: UK recorded-music royalties for performers missing from a recording's line-up
rows.who_can_claim: Performers on a recording in PPL's repertoire that was played in public or broadcast, if the performance qualifies by country or residence.
rows.how_to_claim: Join PPL as a performer and submit a performer claim in myPPL if you are not on the line-up. PPL may ask for evidence. Missing tracks go to the rightsholder.
rows.rule: The page states no claim deadline. It notes that UK performers' equitable remuneration rights last 70 years from when the recording is made or released.
rows.cost: No fee stated on the page

usc-115.publisher: United States Congress (Cornell LII copy of the U.S. Code)
usc-115.title: 17 U.S.C. 115: Scope of exclusive rights in nondramatic musical works, compulsory license for making and distributing phonorecords
usc-115.support: Subsections (a) and (b) on eligibility and notices; (d) on the blanket license, MLC duties, holding, distribution of unclaimed accrued royalties, songwriter share and audits.
usc-115.edition: Title 17, section 115, as shown by LII

mlc-unclaimed.title: Unclaimed Accrued Royalties
mlc-unclaimed.support: Defines unclaimed accrued royalties as unmatched plus unclaimed; intends to begin distributions in April 2027 through market share, starting with January 2021 blanket usage; dashboard for 2021 usage.

mlc-historical.title: Historical Royalties
mlc-historical.support: 2007 to 2020 streaming; 21 DSPs; liability limit for transfer by 15 Feb 2021; about $427M cut to about $397M; first matched payouts given as May 2022 and June 2022; market share for remainder not begun (Nov 2026 data).
mlc-historical.edition: Dashboard text states data current as of November 2026

mlc-missing-members.title: Missing Member Lookup
mlc-missing-members.support: Searchable list of rightsholders not yet Members who may be owed US digital audio mechanicals; royalties shown exclude historical unmatched royalties.

mlc-pr-2026-09.title: The MLC Holds Annual Membership Meeting: Highlights More Than $4.2 Billion in Total Royalties Distributed and Announces Date of First Monthly Market Share Distribution
mlc-pr-2026-09.support: 30 September 2026: April 2027 start, one month at a time from January 2021; pro rata by DSP and offering; more than six years of matching; nearly $5B processed, $4.2B distributed; $239M historical; 100,000 Members; 60M works.

sx-owed.title: For artists, labels and producers: are you owed royalties?
sx-owed.support: 'Are you owed royalties' section: registration needed to be paid; search with four unregistered lists; registration and SX Direct free; no time limit given. Fetch tool only (403 direct).

cmrra-unclaimed.title: Unclaimed Works Portal
cmrra-unclaimed.support: Publishers with a CMRRA Direct account match unmatched recordings and add missing shares via the Unclaimed Works menu; quarterly invoicing follows. No fee stated. Fetch tool only (403 direct).

ppl-performers.title: Performers: claiming and eligibility
ppl-performers.support: Performer claim via myPPL if not on line-up; recording must be in repertoire and played or broadcast; qualifying-country rule; no fee or deadline stated. Fetch tool only (403 direct).
